paper.title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events
paper.license: arXiv non-exclusive distribution license 1.0 (read and cite; no redistribution of the text)
paper.method: OFI over 10-second intervals from best bid/ask price and size changes; OLS of mid-price change (ticks) on OFI per half-hour subsample; price impact coefficient vs average depth by log-log and linear fits

definitions.e_n: e_n = I{P^B_n >= P^B_{n-1}} q^B_n - I{P^B_n <= P^B_{n-1}} q^B_{n-1} - I{P^A_n <= P^A_{n-1}} q^A_n + I{P^A_n >= P^A_{n-1}} q^A_{n-1}  (source .tex, section 2.1)
definitions.OFI_k: sum of e_n over events in [t_{k-1}, t_k]
definitions.Delta_P_k: (P_k - P_{k-1}) / delta, P = mid-quote at t_k, delta = tick size
definitions.AD_i: AD_i = 1 / (2 (N(T_i) - N(T_{i-1}) - 1)) * sum_{n in half-hour i} (q^B_n + q^A_n)
definitions.regression: Delta_P_k = alpha_i + beta_i OFI_k + eps_k, OLS per half-hour subsample i, Delta t = 10 s, White heteroscedasticity-consistent SE, z-test at 95%
definitions.depth_relation: beta_i = c / AD_i^lambda + nu_i; lambda via log beta_i = a - lambda log AD_i, then c via linear fit

missing_info: TAQ quote/trade matching details (Appendix A) do not apply to a single crypto venue
Paper is equities with 1-cent ticks during exchange hours; crypto is 24/7 with a different tick and size unit
paper.verified_by: Claude, 2026-10-21: arXiv abstract page and the author LaTeX source (e-print), sections 2-3, Tables 2-3 and footnote on the price-changing-events tautology

claims.statement: Over 10-second intervals, mid-price changes are linear in contemporaneous order flow imbalance, with high explanatory power and a significant price impact coefficient in nearly all half-hour subsamples.
claims.dataset: NYSE TAQ, 50 stocks, 273 half-hour subsamples per stock

reported.source: Table 2 'Average' row: R^2 65%, {beta != 0} 97%; quadratic term raises R^2 only to 68%

claims.notes: Contemporaneous relation, not a forecast. Footnote: excluding price-changing events from OFI lowers R^2 to 35-60% (tautology check).

claims.statement: The price impact coefficient is inversely related to market depth, beta_i = c / AD_i^lambda with lambda close to 1.
claims.dataset: NYSE TAQ, 50 stocks, 273 estimates of beta_i per stock

assumptions.chosen: Binance spot BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT, public bookTicker (best bid/ask price and size), 24/7
assumptions.rationale: Free, key-less L1 data reachable from Germany; tests whether an equity result transfers to crypto (domain shift, labelled ADAPTED).

assumptions.chosen: Each bookTicker message is one event n; consecutive messages define e_n; the first message after a (re)connect only sets the state
assumptions.rationale: bookTicker carries best bid/ask price and size, exactly the inputs of e_n; no e_n is computed across a gap.

assumptions.chosen: NTP-corrected local receive time (bookTicker has no event time)
assumptions.rationale: Network jitter blurs 10 s boundaries slightly; recorded, not corrected.

assumptions.chosen: Delta_P in ticks with the symbol's exchangeInfo PRICE_FILTER tickSize at collection start
Delta t = 10 s; consecutive 30-minute UTC windows; a window with > 5% missing seconds is excluded and counted
assumptions.rationale: Paper's grid; gaps are never back-filled.

assumptions.chosen: AD_i = mean over events of (q^B_n + q^A_n) / 2 in the window
assumptions.rationale: Paper's AD_i (the -1 in the paper's denominator is immaterial at thousands of events).

brian_hypotheses.statement: OFI over the previous 10 s predicts the sign of the next 10 s mid-price change strongly enough to beat round-trip taker costs.
brian_hypotheses.test: Days 1-7 (tuning): choose the |OFI| quantile threshold from {0.90, 0.95, 0.99} by gross mean; days 8-14 (untouched test): simulated taker entry at the ask/bid after a signal, exit after 10 s at the bid/ask, minus Binance taker fee on both sides (fee recorded at start).
brian_hypotheses.expected: Likely FAIL: 10 s moves are usually smaller than spread + 2 x fee. A FAIL is a valid, money-saving result.

C-01.PASS: median half-hour R^2 >= 0.50 AND beta > 0 significant (White SE, 95%) in >= 90% of valid windows, per symbol
C-01.FAIL: median R^2 < 0.20 OR significant positive beta in < 50% of valid windows

C-02.PASS: lambda_hat > 0 with day-clustered bootstrap 95% interval excluding 0

brian:ofi-predictive-v1.PASS: test-period mean net return per trade > 0 bps with day-clustered bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0

decision_rule.INSUFFICIENT_DATA: fewer than 200 valid half-hour windows per symbol (C-01/C-02) or fewer than 100 test-period trades (hypothesis)
decision_rule.REVIEW_REQUIRED: more than 5% of collection seconds missing overall, or any disk/clock guard tripped

preregistration.not_a_trade_signal: Results are shadow research; nothing is traded or promoted automatically.

amendments.change: Fixed analysis parameters: taker fee 10 bps per side (Binance spot VIP0 published rate; the public stream does not expose account fees), threshold quantiles {0.90, 0.95, 0.99} chosen on days 1-7 by gross mean, test days = day 8 onward. Analysis code: research/research_lab/studies/ofi_binance/analyze.py (stdlib, 10 offline tests).
